fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami municipal affairs, including criticism of City Manager Wharton and discussion of Mayor Sewell and the Chamber of Commerce’s handling of city publicity funds. Coverage also addresses a campaign against drunken drivers, proposals and considerations for an airport site (including Biscayne Bay and Dinner Key), and Miami Beach coastal erosion and bond financing. Regular columns and local items appear alongside Prohibition enforcement news, entertainment notices, and sports coverage including a boxing card at Ball Park.
